title: Personal Checking: overdraft item fee charged on an item at or below the de minimis amount
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to the bank-error review of the most recently posted overdraft item fee on a Personal Checking account. It concerns the size of the item that carried the fee.

## Formal clause

The overdraft item fee is also a bank error when the item's amount is the tier's per-item overdraft de minimis amount or less.

The amount compared is the amount of the item named as the fee's source item; the figure it is compared with is the per-item de minimis amount of the checking account's tier.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical de minimis amount of 7.00 USD, chosen only for illustration)

| Amount of the item that carried the fee | Reading on this ground |
|---|---|
| 6.99 USD | Bank error |
| 7.00 USD | Bank error: "or less" includes the amount itself |
| 7.01 USD | No bank error on this ground |

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Does it matter whether the linked savings account could have paid the item?**
A: Not for this ground. An item at or below the de minimis amount makes the fee a bank error on its own.

**Q: Is it the fee amount or the item amount that is compared with the de minimis amount?**
A: The item's amount.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "a small fee is a de minimis error". **Correct basis:** the test is on the item's amount, not on the fee's.
